platform.captionText: Choose the foundation that fits the work.

ownership.captionText: Keep the website and its accounts in your control.

cost.captionText: A useful quote starts with the work the site needs to do.

mobile.captionText: Make the customer’s next step just as clear on a phone.

forms.captionText: An inquiry should have a clear place to go.

web-redesign-decision.captionText: Start by deciding what needs care and what needs replacing.

web-accessibility-basics.captionText: Make the first path easier for more people to use.

web-content-collection.captionText: Gather the real details customers need before the build begins.

web-service-page.captionText: Give each service a clear way to explain itself.

web-photos-with-purpose.captionText: Choose photographs that help someone understand the work.

web-menu-and-hours.captionText: Make the details of a visit easy to find at the right moment.

web-ecommerce-inventory.captionText: A shop should show what customers can actually buy.

wifi.captionText: Place the connection where the work actually happens.

email.captionText: Help important messages reach the people waiting for them.

backup.captionText: A second copy is most useful when it is kept somewhere separate.

it-shared-files.captionText: Put the needed file where the next person can find it.

consulting-first-priority.captionText: Start with the work that needs attention first.

consulting-tool-choice.captionText: Keep the tools that help and question the duplicates.

software-repeat-work.captionText: Let one clear action replace work that gets repeated.

software-approval-path.captionText: Make the next decision and its owner easy to see.
